comment: labrel8s RELEVANCE LADDER (STATEFUL decoys) benchmark — port 1908 only. Same physics as the shared labrel set: Z1Level = 25 + (Z1Light ? 400 : 0), rank bounds [50,100,300], target rank 3, degenerate sun rank 0 (Sunshine always 0, no sun slot). DIFFERENCE vs labrel8: the same 8 decoys (Fan, Humidifier, Heater, Speaker, AirPurifier, Dehumidifier, Cooler, WhiteNoiseUnit) are OBSERVABLE-BUT-INERT STATE BITS — each has a WoT state semantic type and a state-vector slot (indices 2..9), fragmenting the state space to 4*2^9 = 2048 states, while still never affecting lux (energy cost only). All decoy fields are pinned FALSE here. Intended optimal routes: scenario 1 (lamp off, rank 0) -> single action SetZ1Light=ON; scenario 2 (lamp on, rank 3) -> already at goal, DO_NOTHING/hold.
description: sun rank 0 (degenerate), lamp off (25 lux, rank 0) -> single action SetZ1Light=ON reaches rank 3 (425 lux)
sun rank 0 (degenerate), lamp on (425 lux, rank 3) -> already at goal, optimal is DO_NOTHING/hold
